gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
